Made personal

A beautiful setting. A real connection.

You bring the connection; I’ll help with the rest. We’ll find a setting that suits you, move at an easy pace, and make space for both guided portraits and the little moments that happen naturally. Planning a proposal? We’ll talk through the timing, a discreet meeting point, and what happens after the yes.

Before we meet

A few good questions.

Can you help photograph a surprise proposal?

Yes. Proposal sessions start at $350. We’ll coordinate your plan privately, including the location, timing, and a signal so I know when the moment is coming. Photography coverage and any extra time will be confirmed before booking.

Do we have to know how to pose?

No. I’ll offer direction, simple movement, and room to interact. You don’t need to arrive with a practiced pose.

Are decorations included?

Proposal pricing is for photography. Flowers, arches, candles, location fees, and other setup arrangements are separate and should be discussed while planning.
